input: # Documents ZON's render (alchemy/render.alc) writes, as alchemy runs it,
# each under a comment holding the JSON value it was given, and the value
# every reader reads from them. The render writes each field name by the
# convention the manifest's loss lines state, and their reverse turns the
# name read back into the name given: $empty is the empty name, $json: and
# a text the string the text spells as a JSON string, $$ and a rest $ and
# the rest, any other name as it is. So two names are never written as one
# An object whose only member is $big, holding an integer as the reader
# spells one, is written as that integer; one whose $big holds any other
# string is written as a struct, its field $$big, never as an integer
# ZON refuses. A big integer itself, which the readers hold as a bigint,
# a *big.Int and {"$big": digits}, no fixture can spell: each runtime's
